prompt_all8.normalization_rule: per-family rate = 1 / sum(TT_s); never one common prompt time

atm511_sidecar.model_scope: semiempirical atmospheric 511-keV sidecar; not native EXPACS

selection_contract.active_veto_volume_rule: BGO/CsI active scintillator + ActiveShield/CEBR3 + GeoOpt_S2B_CryoShell_Plastic*; W/Al mechanical shell excluded

side_compton_fov.knob0_policy: frozen current monotonic policy; literal S0/S1-retain rule is not promoted

selection_policy.scorer_scope: retained byte-identical 40-mm side scorer plus O8 30-mm bottom and 10-mm top scorers
selection_policy.systematic_disclosure: Cosima native BGO detector blocks use 80 keV, while postprocessing sums matched active deposits and applies <50 keV; both settings are frozen across the matched heavy-control/O8 comparison.

claim_boundary: PENDING is not zero and is not transport evidence. No Step05-Step08 result summary is created until screening and every production input pass.
